join_policy: Candidate records share mechanisms or conversion gaps; they are not person-, firm-, place-, or event-level joins.

candidates.title: Formal response arrives before usable recovery
candidates.mechanism: formal output -> implementation gap -> repeated effort, waiting, residual loss, or non-use
candidates.counter_signal: Some cases reach payment, continued work, restoration, or improved access.
candidates.next_comparison: Code the same remedy, implementation, receipt, recovery, and exit stages across labor, consumer, health, and public-service records.

candidates.title: Time and financial pressure reduce practical room before demand disappears
candidates.mechanism: material or care pressure -> hidden time price and coordination work -> substitution, delayed completion, or unequal participation
candidates.counter_signal: Flexible schedules, paid support, community infrastructure, or higher resources can preserve participation.
candidates.next_comparison: Keep participant and total-population denominators separate and distinguish nominal spending from quantities, access, and wellbeing.

candidates.title: Digital capability expands while control and trust remain contested
candidates.mechanism: capability or convenience -> delegated control and platform dependency -> trust, portability, explanation, or correction gap
candidates.counter_signal: Delegation can be preferred when stakes are low and control, human review, or switching remain credible.
candidates.next_comparison: Separate task efficiency from later correction, retention, switching, and institutional legitimacy.

candidates.title: Infrastructure dependency becomes cultural and geopolitical power
candidates.mechanism: capacity or ownership concentration -> dependency and unequal access -> local burden, public legitimacy, resilience, or state leverage
candidates.counter_signal: Redundancy, public governance, open access, local benefits, and credible substitutes can create shared capacity.
candidates.next_comparison: Link operation, actual user receipt, local incidence, maintenance, and later behavior; announced capacity is not reliable benefit.
